reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: From a theory of mind perspective, these 108 unmodelled fields represent the private knowledge states of opposing analysts, coaches, and rival algorithms. If a specific betting exchange or analytics site is tracking a micro-metric that we have filtered out, they possess a localized advantage. Our engine must simulate their cognition by asking: 'What does this external host know that I do not?' Integrating these fields is essentially reverse-engineering the mental models of the broader sports intelligence ecosystem.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict cross-layer veto must be applied here to prevent dimensional collapse. Many of these 108 fields may be highly collinear with existing GSE primitives (e.g., a new 'pass accuracy' metric might just be a noisy re-sampling of our existing completion probability). Blindly ingesting them would introduce multicollinearity, destabilizing our Bayesian posterior updates. Furthermore, we must veto any field whose temporal granularity mismatches our core clock, preventing leakage from future states into present predictions during backtesting.
